hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 ≤ C. In that case, use the existing proof. Otherwise C ≤ 0; choose B = 0. All factors multiplying C are nonnegative: the squared terms are nonnegative, and r ≥ 1, α > 0, δ > 0 ensure the inverse powers and their minima with 1 are nonnegative, including when N = 0. Repeatedly applying mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg makes the left side ≤ 0, while the right side equals 0.
